case_title: Ajai Kumar Son Of Late Shri Om Prakash vs Motor Accident Claims Tribunal, ...

parties.appellant_petitioner: Ajai Kumar Son Of Late Shri Om Prakash

decision_evidence: 7. In view of above, the writ petition is allowed and the judgment and orders dated 1.10.2002 and 3.3.2003 passed by the Motor Accident Claims Tribunal, Moradabad, contained respectively in Annexures 2 and 3 to the petition are quashed. The Tribunal shall reopen the proceedings, hear the case on merits and conclude the controversy expeditiously.
